description: This file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy' for a module that cleans up poorly written HTML by applying various fixes based on levels. It includes methods for setup, retrieving fixes for levels, populating fixes, and parsing fix names.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy
classes.description: An abstract class for a set of proprietary modules that clean up (tidy) poorly written HTML, supporting different levels of fixes and dynamic fix application.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the module by creating fixes, determining the level, and populating the module with necessary fixes based on configuration.

methods.name: getFixesForLevel
methods.description: Returns all fixes applicable for a given level, including those for lower levels.

methods.name: makeFixesForLevel
methods.description: Populates the fixesForLevel array based on provided fixes, considering default level.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the module with fixes and transformations based on a list of fixes passed to it.

methods.name: getFixType
methods.description: Parses a fix name to determine its type and parameters.

methods.name: makeFixes
methods.description: Defines all fixes the module will perform; returns an empty array in this abstract class.
